pageContent: Manu AI Chatbot is a modern, state-of-the-art conversational AI platform designed for intelligent document ingestion, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Built using LangChain, LangGraph, Next.js, and Supabase Vector Store, it allows users to upload documents and query them with contextual awareness and accurate citations.

Core Capabilities of Manu AI Chatbot:
- Document Ingestion Pipeline: Automatically extracts, chunks, and embeds PDF documents into vector embeddings.
- Semantic Retrieval: Performs high-precision similarity search against vector embeddings using pgvector.
- Intelligent Routing: Evaluates user queries to either retrieve document context or answer general queries directly.
- Real-Time Streaming: Uses Server-Sent Events (SSE) to stream partial tokens and UI updates to the user instantly.
- Enterprise Grade Architecture: Modular monorepo with Turborepo, TypeScript, and modern React components.

System Configuration & Integration:
Manu AI Chatbot supports various LLM providers including OpenAI (gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Ollama, and Groq. The vector store can be configured with Supabase pgvector or customized for other providers. Deployment is streamlined for Vercel and LangGraph Cloud.
